result.evidence: 0:00-0:25: Hook explains why walls show a uniform glow. 0:26-1:08: Visual construction of the pinhole model showing how an inverted image forms. 1:09-1:54: Demonstration of aperture size affecting sharpness and brightness. 1:55-2:39: Demonstration showing that moving the pinhole moves the image. 2:40-3:23: Contrasts light received at a single wall point with and without a barrier. 3:24-3:58: Consolidation and prediction of image size changes.
result.score_reason: The lesson teaches the core idea clearly through excellent, logical visual demonstrations. It fully meets the 'Good' level. It is kept from a higher level due to the lack of audio narration, which requires more reading effort, and slightly fast pacing when equations are introduced.
